notes: The version of record prints the same two intervals as the repository copy, in the same three places: Abstract (p. i84) "4.0 (3.8 to 4.1)"; Results (p. i85) "4.0 (UI: 3.8 to 4.1)"; Discussion (p. i86) "4.0 (3.6–4.1)". Supplementary table S1 (the table the Results cite) prints 4.0 (3.8 to 4.1) for the global age-standardised rate in 2017, so 3.8–4.1 is the interval carried by the data table and 3.6–4.1 appears only once, in the Discussion. An erratum exists: Inj Prev 2020;26(Suppl 1):i166 (28 Sep 2020, doi 10.1136/injuryprev-2019-043484corr1), but it corrects authorship and affiliations only and says nothing about any figure, so neither interval has been formally corrected. No change to row gbd-2017-franklin-rate is proposed: it already cites 3.8–4.1 and explains the discrepancy. The reviewer may wish to add to its note that the version of record and its erratum were checked on 21 Oct 2026 and that S1 prints 3.8 to 4.1. Page numbers are the journal's (i84–i86), read from the running header of each PDF page; PMC's citation line prints "Suppl 1" while the BMJ URL path says "Suppl_2".
